rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the funeral ceremony itself.

example.traditional: 聽日朝早係阿嫲嘅葬禮。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 hai6 aa3 maa4 ge3 zong3 lai5

rows.note: Use this when referring more broadly to the funeral and the mourning arrangements rather than only the ceremony.

example.english: Their family has been busy arranging the funeral recently.
example.traditional: 佢屋企最近忙緊辦喪事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 gan6 mong4 gan2 baan6 song1 si6
